name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: fd2_ prefix + domain 'chapter_02' (02 is a meaningful chapter ID 1-30, must be preserved) + descriptor 'end' (chapter-end handler). No Ghidra address residue. Confirmed slot 1 of the chapter-end handler pointer table @ 0x51DE9 (table[0]=0x22ef6 chapter_01_end, table[1] @ 0x51DED = 0x22f37); dispatched via CALL [id*4 + 0x51DE9].
purpose: Chapter 2 (羅德鎮) end handler: grants a reward if all 6 villagers survived, plays the closing cutscene, recruits 弓兵希莉亞, and advances the chapter id.
logic_summary: Scans runtime chars[5..0xA] (the 6 villager units); if any has flags bit0 set (dead) shows failure dialog page 7, else shows page 6 and grants item 0xC6 (力量藥水, AP+9) to the first player char. Then runs the post-battle cutscene: pan_cursor_and_window(0xE,2); load portraits race 4; delay 100ms; cutscene event 0xE; dialog page 8 (reset battle_anim_phase=0; delay 200ms); cutscene event 0xF; dialog page 9 (reset battle_anim_phase=0; delay 200ms); pan_cursor_and_window(0xE,1); delay 200ms; cutscene event 0x10; delay 200ms; dialog page 10. Recruits char #8 (弓兵希莉亞) via init_runtime_char_from_base_growth(8), persists the party (save_runtime_char_to_template), then writes current_chapter_id = 2 (direct literal assignment, like chapter_01_end, not the INC pattern used by most siblings).

returns.semantics: No return value; side effects only (party state, recruit, dialog/cutscene rendering, current_chapter_id update).

notes: Comment block (chend1.c lines 33-50) is already accurate and precise: villager scan chars[5..0xA] dead->page7/alive->page6+力量藥水, cutscene events 0xE/0xF/0x10 with dialog pages 8/9/10, recruit char #8 (弓兵希莉亞), direct current_chapter_id=2 write. Verified vs decompile and fd2-knowledge (item 0xC6 = 力量藥水 AP+9; char #8 = 希莉亞 archer; chapter 2 = 羅德鎮, walkthrough failure condition '索爾死亡，村民全滅', 3 male + 3 female villagers = 6 friendly units matching chars[5..0xA]).
